items.name: armorpaint
items.description: 3D 模型纹理绘制工具。这是一款 3D PBR 纹理绘制工具，直接拖入模型即可开始编辑并实时预览。它提供节点编辑器和 UV 编辑，支持 OBJ、FBX、Blend、glTF 等模型格式，适用于 Windows、Linux 和 macOS 等平台。
items.description_en: 3D Model Texture Painting Tool.A 3D PBR texture painting tool that lets you drag in a model to start editing and preview changes in real time. It features a node editor and UV editing, supports model formats such as OBJ, FBX, Blend, and glTF, and is available on Windows, Linux, and macOS.

items.name: iPhoneMirror
items.description: Windows 上的 iPhone 投屏工具。这是一款 Windows 本地投屏工具，可通过 USB 或 AirPlay 传输 iPhone/iPad 画面和声音，支持多设备、独立窗口、截图、OBS、蓝牙鼠标和键盘控制。
items.description_en: iPhone Screen Mirroring Tool on Windows.A local Windows screen mirroring tool that transmits iPhone/iPad screen and audio via USB or AirPlay, with support for multiple devices, independent windows, screenshots, OBS, and Bluetooth mouse and keyboard control.

items.name: QuickLook
items.description: Windows 的空格键快速预览工具。这是一款 Windows 文件预览工具，提供类似 macOS 快速预览文件的功能，支持图片、视频、文档、代码、压缩包和 3D 模型等 100 多种格式。
items.description_en: Spacebar Quick Preview Tool for Windows.This is a Windows file preview tool that provides macOS Quick Look-like functionality, supporting over 100 formats including images, videos, documents, code, archives, and 3D models.

items.name: RHI
items.description: 一键为游戏开启 HDR 的工具。这是一款 Windows 的游戏画质增强工具，能够自动扫描游戏并一键安装 ReShade 和对应的 HDR 模组，支持切换 DLSS 版本、自动开关系统 HDR、限制帧率和管理 NVIDIA 驱动配置。
items.description_en: One-Click HDR Enabler for Games.This Windows game graphics enhancement tool automatically scans for games and installs ReShade and matching HDR mods with one click. It supports switching DLSS versions, automatically toggling system HDR, limiting frame rates, and managing NVIDIA driver configurations.

items.name: flameshot
items.description: 开源的跨平台截图工具。这是一款基于 C++ 和 Qt 开发的截图工具，可在截图上直接添加箭头、文字、形状和马赛克，支持延时截图、复制到剪贴板、上传到 Imgur 等功能，适用于 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 系统。
items.description_en: Open-Source Cross-Platform Screenshot Tool.This is a screenshot tool built with C++ and Qt. It lets you add arrows, text, shapes, and mosaic effects directly to screenshots, with support for delayed capture, copying to clipboard, uploading to Imgur, and more. It runs on Windows, macOS, and Linux.

items.name: bilirec
items.description: 适用于低配设备的 B 站直播录制工具。该项目是专为低配设备优化的 B 站直播录制工具，内存占用极少。它内置 Web 管理界面，支持开播自动录制、自动分段、断流重连和自动转 MP4 等功能。
items.description_en: Bilibili Live Recording Tool for Low-Spec Devices.This project is a Bilibili live recording tool optimized for low-spec devices, with a minimal memory footprint. It features a built-in web management interface and supports automatic recording when a stream starts, auto-segmentation, reconnection after stream interruptions, and automatic MP4 conversion.

items.name: hey
items.description: 小巧的 HTTP 压测工具。这是一款用 Go 编写的 Web 压测命令行工具，能够按请求数和并发数向目标地址发送请求，并输出吞吐量、延迟分布和状态码等统计结果，支持按时长压测、HTTP/2、自定义请求方法和请求头等功能。
items.description_en: A Lightweight HTTP Load Testing Tool.This is a command-line web load testing tool written in Go. It can send requests to a target URL based on request count and concurrency level, and outputs statistics such as throughput, latency distribution, and status codes. It supports duration-based load testing, HTTP/2, custom request methods, and custom request headers.

items.name: kserve
items.description: K8s 上的 AI 模型推理平台。该项目是基于 K8s 的 AI 推理平台，支持 vLLM 后端和 OpenAI 兼容接口，可部署 TensorFlow、PyTorch、scikit-learn、ONNX 等多种框架的模型，并提供自动扩缩容、灰度发布和模型监控等功能。
items.description_en: AI Model Inference Platform on K8s.This project is a K8s-based AI inference platform that supports the vLLM backend and OpenAI-compatible APIs. It can deploy models built with various frameworks, including TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit-learn, and ONNX, and offers features such as autoscaling, canary releases, and model monitoring.

items.name: PMail
items.description: 一分钟搭建个人域名邮箱。该项目是用 Go 编写的个人邮件服务器，仅需一台服务器和域名，就能部署自己的域名邮箱。它开箱即用、体积小、占用资源少，内置邮件收发服务和 Web 管理界面，支持 SMTP、POP3、IMAP 协议，以及多域名、多用户和 HTTPS 证书自动续期等功能。
items.description_en: Set Up a Personal Domain Email in One Minute.This project is a personal mail server written in Go. With just a server and a domain, you can deploy your own domain email. It works out of the box, is compact, and uses minimal resources. It includes built-in mail sending and receiving plus a web admin interface, and supports SMTP, POP3, and IMAP, along with multiple domains, multiple users, and automatic HTTPS certificate renewal.

items.name: ccstatusline
items.description: Claude Code 的状态栏定制工具。这是一款专为 Claude Code 设计的状态栏工具，可在底部实时显示当前模型、Git 分支、Token 用量、上下文占比、每周额度和会话时长等信息。它内置交互式配置界面，支持自定义显示项、多行状态栏和导出配置。
items.description_en: Claude Code Status Bar Customization Tool.A status bar tool designed specifically for Claude Code that displays real-time information at the bottom, including the current model, Git branch, token usage, context percentage, weekly quota, and session duration. It features a built-in interactive configuration interface and supports custom display items, multi-line status bars, and configuration export.

items.name: claude-opus-5-5-demo
items.description: 一句提示词生成的 3D 网页游戏。该项目是 Claude Opus 5.5 代码生成实测的产物，包含鹈鹕骑车、射击和赛车三款 3D 网页游戏。每个游戏仅用一句提示词，由模型自主完成开发、测试和部署，源码没有人工改动过一行。
items.description_en: 3D Web Games Generated from a Single Prompt.This project is the product of a hands-on code generation test with Claude Opus 5.5, featuring three 3D web games: a pelican riding a bike, a shooting game, and a racing game. Each game was created from just one prompt, with the model autonomously handling development, testing, and deployment—not a single line of the source code was manually changed.

items.name: edgeever
items.description: AI 原生的个人笔记应用。这是一款开源的笔记与知识库应用，采用印象笔记经典的三栏布局，可零成本部署在 Cloudflare 上。它提供 REST API、MCP 和 CLI 接口，适配 Claude Code 等 AI 智能体读取和整理笔记，支持多设备同步、Mermaid 图表、版本历史、Markdown 和富文本等功能。
items.description_en: AI-Native Personal Note-Taking App.An open-source notes and knowledge base app with Evernote's classic three-column layout, deployable on Cloudflare at zero cost. It provides REST API, MCP, and CLI interfaces, making it easy for AI agents like Claude Code to read and organize notes. It supports multi-device sync, Mermaid diagrams, version history, Markdown, rich text, and more.

items.name: microlighter
items.description: 零依赖的代码高亮库。该项目是基于 CSS Highlight API 的网页代码高亮库，无需为每个 Token 插入 span 标签，让 DOM 结构更简洁。它压缩后仅约 2KB，内置 10 套主题，支持 30 多种编程语言、可编辑代码块和自动高亮等功能。
items.description_en: Zero-Dependency Code Highlighting Library.This project is a web code highlighting library based on the CSS Highlight API. It doesn't require inserting span tags for every token, resulting in a cleaner DOM structure. It's only ~2KB minified and comes with 10 built-in themes, supporting 30+ programming languages, editable code blocks, automatic highlighting, and more.

items.name: openmouse
items.description: 免装驱动的网页版游戏鼠标设置工具。这是一款基于浏览器的游戏鼠标控制面板，连接鼠标后即可查看设备信息，调整 DPI、回报率等设置，不用安装驱动软件。它通过 WebHID 与鼠标通信，支持罗技、雷蛇、海盗船、HyperX、VGN、ATK 等品牌的鼠标。
items.description_en: Driver-Free Web-Based Gaming Mouse Configuration Tool.This is a browser-based control panel for gaming mice. Once connected, you can view device information and adjust settings such as DPI and polling rate without installing any driver software. It communicates with the mouse via WebHID and supports mice from brands including Logitech, Razer, Corsair, HyperX, VGN, ATK, and more.

items.name: figures4papers
items.description: 绘制论文配图的 Python 脚本集合。该项目是一套用于制作论文配图的工具，内含 Python 脚本和 AI Skills，支持绘制对比柱状图、构成分解图、趋势图等多种学术图表。
items.description_en: A Collection of Python Scripts for Creating Academic Paper Figures.This project is a toolkit for creating figures for academic papers. It includes Python scripts and AI Skills, and supports a variety of academic charts such as comparison bar charts, composition breakdown diagrams, trend charts, and more.

items.name: flet
items.description: 用 Python 开发跨平台应用的框架。该项目是基于 Flutter 的 Python 应用开发框架，只用 Python 就能构建 Web、桌面和移动应用，支持 iOS、Android、Windows、macOS、Linux 和浏览器。它内置 Material 和 Cupertino 风格组件，可在移动应用中使用 NumPy、pandas 等库，并能通过一条命令打包发布到 App Store 和 Google Play。
items.description_en: A Framework for Building Cross-Platform Apps in Python.This project is a Flutter-based Python app development framework that lets you build web, desktop, and mobile apps using only Python. It supports iOS, Android, Windows, macOS, Linux, and the browser. It comes with built-in Material and Cupertino-style components, allows the use of libraries like NumPy and pandas in mobile apps, and can package and publish to the App Store and Google Play with a single command.

items.name: kr8s
items.description: 用 Python 轻松操作 K8s。这是一个受 kubectl 启发的 K8s Python 客户端库，熟悉 kubectl 命令即可快速上手。它提供同步和异步 API，支持获取资源、扩缩容、创建 Pod 和端口转发等常用操作。
items.description_en: Effortlessly Manage K8s with Python.A kubectl-inspired Python client library for K8s that lets you hit the ground running if you already know kubectl commands. It offers both synchronous and asynchronous APIs, supporting common operations such as fetching resources, scaling, creating Pods, and port forwarding.

items.name: linkding-cn
items.description: 中文版书签管理与稍后读工具。该项目是基于 linkding 二次开发的书签管理和稍后读工具，内置简体中文界面。它支持网页快照、正文提取、高亮批注、拼音标签搜索和数据看板，部署简单开箱即用。
items.description_en: Chinese Bookmark Management and Read-It-Later Tool.This project is a bookmark management and read-it-later tool built as a customized fork of linkding, with a built-in Simplified Chinese interface. It supports webpage snapshots, article extraction, highlights and annotations, pinyin tag search, and data dashboards, and is easy to deploy and ready to use out of the box.

items.name: pywebview
items.description: 用 Web 技术打造 Python 桌面应用。这是一个轻量级的 Python 原生 WebView 封装库，可用网页技术构建原生窗口，实现前端与 Python 双向通信。它复用系统网页组件，生成的程序体积小，适用于 Windows、macOS、Linux 和 Android。
items.description_en: Building Python Desktop Apps with Web Technologies.This is a lightweight Python native WebView wrapper library that lets you build native windows using web technologies and enables two-way communication between the frontend and Python. It reuses the system's web components, resulting in small application sizes, and works on Windows, macOS, Linux, and Android.

items.name: broot
items.description: 更好用的 tree 命令替代工具。这是一款用 Rust 编写的终端目录浏览工具，能够以精简的目录树展示大型文件夹，并自动忽略 .gitignore 中的文件。它支持模糊搜索、正则表达式和搜索文件内容，输入几个字母即可跳转到目标目录。还提供多面板文件操作、文件预览、批量命令执行和自定义快捷键等功能，可替代 tree 和 ls 命令。
items.description_en: A Better Alternative to the tree Command.This terminal directory browser is written in Rust and can display large folders as a streamlined directory tree while automatically ignoring files listed in .gitignore. It supports fuzzy search, regular expressions, and file content search, letting you jump to a target directory by typing just a few letters. It also offers multi-pane file operations, file previews, batch command execution, and customizable shortcuts, making it a replacement for the tree and ls commands.

items.name: numbat
items.description: 能自动换算物理单位的计算器。这是一款兼具编程语言能力的科学计算器，专为带物理单位的科学计算设计。支持单位换算、自定义单位、常数和函数计算，可在命令行或浏览器中使用。
items.description_en: A Calculator That Automatically Converts Physical Units.A scientific calculator with programming language capabilities, designed for scientific computing with physical units. It supports unit conversion, custom units, constants, and functions, and can be used in the command line or browser.

items.name: window-switcher
items.description: 在 Windows 上切换同一应用的多个窗口。这是一款免安装的 Windows 窗口切换工具，按下 Alt+反引号 即可在同一应用的多个窗口间快速切换，也可启用 Alt+Tab 切换应用。支持自定义快捷键、冲突程序黑名单和限定当前虚拟桌面等功能。
items.description_en: Switch Between Multiple Windows of the Same App on Windows.This is a portable Windows window switcher: press Alt+Backtick to quickly switch between multiple windows of the same app, or enable Alt+Tab to switch between applications. It supports custom hotkeys, a blacklist for conflicting programs, and limiting switches to the current virtual desktop, among other features.

items.name: handraw-style
items.description: 手绘风格 AI 生图技能包。这是一个可安装到 Codex 的 AI 生图技能包，收录了 278 种手绘风格、120 种排版样式和 30 种经典主题色。选定编号并说明主题，即可生成中英双语生图提示词，也能根据主题自动推荐风格和配色。它提供社媒卡、信息图、漫画分镜等排版，支持纯图和图文两种模式，生成的提示词适用于 GPT Image、Midjourney、Stable Diffusion 等工具。
items.description_en: Hand-Drawn Style AI Image Generation Skill Pack.This is an AI image generation skill pack installable in Codex, featuring 278 hand-drawn styles, 120 layout styles, and 30 classic theme colors. Select a number and specify a topic to generate bilingual Chinese-English image prompts, or let it automatically recommend styles and color schemes based on the topic. It provides layouts such as social media cards, infographics, and comic storyboards, and supports both image-only and image-with-text modes. The generated prompts work with tools including GPT Image, Midjourney, Stable Diffusion, and more.

items.name: skills-manager
items.description: 统一管理 AI 技能包的工具。这是一款跨平台的 AI 智能体技能管理工具，可将散落在不同工具中的技能集中存入本地仓库，并一键同步到 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等工具。它支持从 Git 仓库、本地文件夹、压缩包和 skills.sh 市场安装技能，还提供技能组合预设、项目级管理、上游更新检测和标签筛选等功能，适用于 Windows、macOS 和 Linux。
items.description_en: A Tool for Unified AI Skill Pack Management.A cross-platform AI agent skill management tool that centralizes skills scattered across different tools into a local repository and syncs them to Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and more with a single click. It supports installing skills from Git repositories, local folders, archives, and the skills.sh marketplace. It also offers skill bundle presets, project-level management, upstream update detection, and tag filtering, and is available on Windows, macOS, and Linux.

items.name: srt-whiteboard-animation
items.description: 把字幕变成手绘动画。这是一个可将 SRT 字幕转换为白板手绘视频的 AI 技能包。它会解析字幕内容，按叙事顺序拆分场景并生成分镜和线稿，再让画面元素随字幕依次出现，通过笔尖连续勾勒、逐步上色，最终导出为 MP4 视频。
items.description_en: Turn Subtitles into Hand-Drawn Animations.This is an AI skill pack that converts SRT subtitles into whiteboard hand-drawn videos. It parses the subtitle content, splits it into scenes in narrative order, and generates storyboards and line art. It then reveals visual elements sequentially alongside the subtitles, using continuous pen strokes and gradual coloring, and finally exports the result as an MP4 video.

items.name: threejs-architecture-effects
items.description: 让 AI 生成逐层搭建的 3D 古建筑。这是一个适用于 Codex、Claude Code 和 Cursor 的 AI 技能，可生成基于 Three.js 的 3D 中式古建网站。建筑会按照砖墙、木构架、斗拱和飞檐的顺序逐步搭建，砖、木、瓦、石等材质均由代码生成，支持拖动时间轴回放搭建过程、旋转缩放视角和查看飞檐特写等功能。
items.description_en: Let AI Generate a 3D Ancient Chinese Building, Built Layer by Layer.This AI skill works with Codex, Claude Code, and Cursor to generate a Three.js-based website featuring 3D traditional Chinese architecture. The building is assembled step by step in the order of brick walls, timber framing, dougong brackets, and upturned eaves. Materials such as brick, wood, tile, and stone are all generated in code. It supports dragging a timeline to replay the construction process, rotating and zooming the view, and inspecting close-ups of the eaves.

items.name: birth
items.description: macOS 启动项管理工具。这是一款免费开源的 macOS 启动项管理工具，可集中查看和管理开机启动项、守护进程及后台程序，支持按名称、路径或 PID 搜索，并一键停用或移除相关程序。
items.description_en: macOS Startup Item Management Tool.This is a free, open-source macOS startup item management tool that lets you centrally view and manage startup items, daemons, and background processes. It supports searching by name, path, or PID, and lets you disable or remove related programs with a single click.

items.name: Thaw
items.description: 按需显隐图标的 Mac 菜单栏管理工具。这是一款免费开源的 macOS 菜单栏管理工具，可隐藏不需要的图标，并通过悬停或快捷键找回。支持按显示器或专注模式切换布局，还能根据电量、Wi-Fi 等条件自动显示图标。
items.description_en: A Mac Menu Bar Management Tool That Shows and Hides Icons on Demand.This is a free, open-source macOS menu bar manager that hides unwanted icons and lets you bring them back by hovering or using keyboard shortcuts. It supports switching layouts per display or Focus mode, and can automatically show icons based on conditions such as battery level, Wi-Fi, and more.

items.name: tinycast
items.description: 极简的 macOS 启动器。这是一款用 Swift 编写的轻量级 macOS 启动器，内存占用不到 100MB，支持文件搜索、剪贴板历史、汇率换算、代码片段、窗口管理和 AI 对话等功能，兼容 Raycast 扩展。
items.description_en: A Minimalist macOS Launcher.A lightweight macOS launcher written in Swift that uses less than 100MB of memory. It supports file search, clipboard history, currency conversion, code snippets, window management, AI chat, and more, and is compatible with Raycast extensions.

items.name: vphone-cli
items.description: 在 Mac 上创建并运行虚拟 iPhone。这是一款适用于 Apple Silicon Mac 的虚拟 iPhone 工具，基于苹果虚拟化框架创建和管理虚拟机，可通过图形启动器或命令行操作，支持文件浏览、截图录屏和剪贴板同步等功能。
items.description_en: Create and Run a Virtual iPhone on Mac.This is a virtual iPhone tool for Apple Silicon Macs that creates and manages virtual machines based on Apple's virtualization framework. It can be operated via a graphical launcher or the command line, and supports file browsing, screenshots and screen recording, and clipboard synchronization.

items.name: ego-lite
items.description: 与 AI 智能体共用且互不干扰的浏览器。这是一款专为人和 AI 智能体共同使用而设计的浏览器。每个 Agent 都在独立空间中执行任务，不会影响正常浏览网页。智能体可直接编写 JavaScript 完成获取页面快照、点击和填写表单等多步操作，从而减少工具调用次数和 Token 消耗。它支持导入 Chrome 的登录状态和书签，可让多个 Agent 并行处理任务，目前仅支持 macOS。
items.description_en: A Browser for Humans and AI Agents to Share Without Interference.This is a browser designed for humans and AI agents to use together. Each agent executes tasks in an isolated space, so normal web browsing is unaffected. Agents can write JavaScript directly to perform multi-step actions such as capturing page snapshots, clicking, and filling out forms, reducing tool calls and Token consumption. It supports importing Chrome login states and bookmarks, allows multiple agents to process tasks in parallel, and currently supports macOS only.

items.name: LoongForge
items.description: 更快地训练大模型和具身模型。该项目是百度开源的模型训练框架，支持主流的 LLM、VLM、扩散和具身模型。它采用多后端架构，提供开箱即用的配置和脚本，支持预训练、SFT 与 LoRA，适配 NVIDIA GPU 和昆仑芯 XPU 异构硬件。
items.description_en: Faster Training of Large-Scale and Embodied Models.This project is an open-source model training framework from Baidu, supporting mainstream LLMs, VLMs, diffusion models, and embodied models. It adopts a multi-backend architecture, provides out-of-the-box configurations and scripts, supports pretraining, SFT, and LoRA, and is compatible with heterogeneous hardware such as NVIDIA GPUs and Kunlunxin XPUs

items.name: orca
items.description: 让多个 AI 编程智能体并行开发的 IDE。这是一款跨平台的 AI 编程智能体编排工具，能够让 Claude Code、Codex 等分别在独立的 Git 工作树中并行运行，并通过同一界面统一管理。它能将同一个提示词同时发送给多个 Agent，对比结果后合并最优方案。还可通过手机 App 查看进度、接收通知和发送指令，适用于 Windows、macOS 和 Linux。
items.description_en: An IDE for Parallel Development with Multiple AI Coding Agents.A cross-platform orchestration tool for AI coding agents that lets Claude Code, Codex, and others run in parallel in separate Git worktrees, all managed through a unified interface. It can send the same prompt to multiple agents at once, compare the results, and merge the best solution. You can also view progress, receive notifications, and send commands via a mobile app. Available on Windows, macOS, and Linux.

items.name: TencentDB-Agent-Memory
items.description: 让多个 AI 智能体共享团队经验。这是一款开源的 AI 智能体团队记忆系统，可将对话、文档和代码整理成可复用的团队记忆，供不同智能体和团队成员共享。它能从对话中提取记忆与技能，将文档和代码转换为 Wiki 和代码图谱，并根据权限将这些内容分配给不同智能体。
items.description_en: Let Multiple AI Agents Share Team Knowledge.This is an open-source team memory system for AI agents that organizes conversations, documents, and code into reusable team memory for different agents and team members to share. It can extract memories and skills from conversations, convert documents and code into wikis and code graphs, and distribute this content to different agents based on permissions.

items.name: YuE
items.description: 先写曲谱再生成歌曲的音乐模型。该项目是开源的歌曲生成模型，输入歌词和风格描述，即可生成包含人声与伴奏的完整歌曲。它会先生成旋律与和弦乐谱，再根据乐谱生成音频，支持编辑曲谱后重新生成歌曲，也能根据参考录音进行翻唱。配套 Skill 还支持生成纯器乐。
items.description_en: Music Model That Writes Sheet Music Before Generating Songs.This open-source song generation model takes lyrics and a style description as input to produce a complete song with vocals and accompaniment. It first generates melody and chord scores, then creates audio from the score. It supports editing the score to regenerate the song, as well as creating covers based on reference recordings. The companion Skill also supports generating purely instrumental music.

items.name: flix
items.description: 基于 ESP32 的四旋翼无人机。该项目是基于 ESP32 的四旋翼无人机，内含 3D 打印机架、接线图和飞控固件。它通过 Wi-Fi 或 ESP-NOW 使用 MAVLink 协议通信，可用 USB 手柄、遥控器或手机操控，并提供无线命令行调试、Gazebo 仿真和用于自动飞行的 Python 库。
items.description_en: ESP32-Based Quadcopter.This project is an ESP32-based quadcopter, including a 3D-printable frame, wiring diagrams, and flight control firmware. It communicates via MAVLink over Wi-Fi or ESP-NOW, can be controlled with a USB gamepad, RC transmitter, or smartphone, and offers wireless command-line debugging, Gazebo simulation, and a Python library for autonomous flight.

items.name: fugleramme
items.description: 听声识鸟的电子墨水相框。该项目是基于树莓派的智能鸟类相框，通过麦克风采集附近的鸟鸣，借助 BirdNET-Go 识别鸟类，再以古典插画的形式展示识别结果。
items.description_en: E-Ink Photo Frame That Identifies Birds by Their Songs.This project is a Raspberry Pi-based smart bird photo frame that captures nearby bird songs with a microphone, identifies bird species using BirdNET-Go, and displays the results as classical illustrations.

items.name: microduck
items.description: 迷你鸭子机器人。该项目是双足鸭子机器人 Microduck 的控制系统。机器人高约 25 厘米、重 800 克，可通过手柄遥控行走，支持加装轮子、叼起物品和摔倒后自行站起。
items.description_en: Mini Duck Robot.This project is the control system for Microduck, a bipedal duck robot. The robot is about 25 cm tall and weighs 800 grams. It can be remotely controlled via a handheld controller to walk, and supports optional wheels, picking up objects, and self-righting after a fall.

items.name: pigsty
items.description: 开箱即用的 PostgreSQL 发行版。这是一个企业级开源 PostgreSQL 发行版，可在 Linux 上一键部署单机实例或高可用集群。它内置监控面板、故障自动切换和时间点恢复等功能，并提供 12 种 PG 内核和 500 多个扩展。
items.description_en: A Ready-to-Use PostgreSQL Distribution.This is an enterprise-grade open-source PostgreSQL distribution that enables one-click deployment of standalone instances or high-availability clusters on Linux. It includes built-in monitoring dashboards, automatic failover, and point-in-time recovery, and provides 12 PG kernels and 500+ extensions.
